task.approach: Voices approach: this slice is a roster, a tip sheet, not your assignment — every citizen with a page on the record, one line each. You pick whose own words carry the day, and why. The person's own line first, before their name; then who they are in one plain clause; then what in the city they were answering, from the page's own tags. Fewer, longer passages; the words are the product. Never a count, never a statistic, never an explanation of what they meant. Facts on this slice: the names, places, roles and numbers listed.
